data.narrative:
Andrenam is a Series A–stage Defense & Security company founded by Matej Cernosek and Alex Chu that has raised $18M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $18M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implied a valuation of $36M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables yielded a median of $400M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous risk profiles and market positions within frontier defense technology.

The triangulated valuation range is $31M to $460M, with a median of $218M across the two methods. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects the high variance in Defense & Security valuations at the Series A stage. Key uncertainties include the appropriate positioning of Andrenam within the peer distribution—whether the company is more comparable to lower-valued peers like NODA AI or higher-capitalized entrants—and the degree to which recent sector momentum affects investor multiples. Resolution of product-market fit and customer concentration risk will materially inform placement within this range.
